messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?

I can only access your own order information, so I can’t tell you who else bought the garden hose reel or whether they returned theirs. I can see that the hose reel in your order was received back by the shop and has not been refunded. Would you like me to check whether it can be refunded?
Yes, please check whether my reel can be refunded. Could you at least share my neighbour’s name or email so I can ask her about her return?

messages.text: Your garden hose reel is eligible for a refund of **BRL 99.00**. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a chat reply won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval). I can’t share another customer’s name or email.
The customer confirmed request prop-dd160933a9c045a2 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.

Your refund of **BRL 99.00** has been recorded in the shop’s test ledger. Receipt number: **R-00000001**. This receipt is not a bank transfer, and the shop can’t provide a date for when money may appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
I wanted the refund, but does “recorded in the test ledger” mean the money has actually been refunded?

The refund is complete in the shop’s records: receipt **R-00000001** confirms it was recorded in the test ledger. It does **not** mean a bank transfer was made, and the shop can’t say when funds might appear on a card (refund-policy/v2/payout).
I want the money returned to me, not just recorded in a test ledger. Can you arrange an actual refund?
